title: Race To The Olympics: Our Athletes' Unprecedented Journey To Tokyo Olympics 2020 | Tokyo Dreams
description:
The road to the Olympics is paved with years of meticulous planning and a lot of discipline and effort. It is no different for para-athletes aiming for the Paralympics. How has the postponement of Tokyo 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic affected first-timers from Singapore? How do they feel about the “simplified” Olympics that’s on the cards? 

Meet five athletes and para-athletes aiming for their first Olympics and Paralympics. See how they are dealing with the situation and what drives them to continue aiming for their dreams.
